dl.phase_prep: Reading packages and preparing the media layout; usually a few minutes.
dl.phase_wim: Compressing install.wim; 5-15 min depending on disk and CPU.
dl.phase_update: Adding updates (SSU, LCU…) to the image; the longest step, can take 20-60 min.
dl.phase_save: Saving the image, recompressing install.wim and updating WinRE; 15-30 min.
dl.phase_build: Updating/compressing boot.wim and writing the ISO; final step, 10-15 min.
notice.title: About UUP Studio
notice.first_run:
A quick note before you start:

• Windows files are downloaded from Microsoft's Windows Update servers. UUP Studio is not affiliated with Microsoft; the license and activation of the Windows in the ISO are your responsibility.
• ISO conversion needs administrator rights. For speed, working folders and DISM processes are temporarily excluded from Windows Defender scanning during conversion and restored afterwards. You can turn this off under Advanced.
• If something goes wrong, use the “Save” button in the Log card and send the file to the developer.
about.credits: Build data comes from UUP dump (uupdump.net); conversion uses uup-converter-wimlib (abbodi1406 and contributors). The interface uses Qt for Python (PySide6, LGPLv3). See THIRD_PARTY.md for details.
about.defender: During conversion, working folders and DISM processes are temporarily excluded from Windows Defender scanning and restored afterwards. Can be turned off under Advanced.
